pages.text: The river fell, exposing its bed. Mom handed out three baskets. "Let's fill them before the water rises again."
Raju wanted a full basket. Only Raju knew where the shellfish were. "Just follow me."
Raju strode ahead. Mina and Sonu hurried behind.
Raju turned over a flat stone. Shellfish rolled out.
Mina dug only sand. Sonu searched only water plants. Their baskets stayed empty.
Water crept upward, wetting their ankles.
All three baskets barely had their bottoms covered—even Raju's.
Mom held Raju's hand. "The water is rising. Let's leave. Will you show your siblings how to find shellfish, too?"
On the way out, Raju explained, "Look beneath flat stones!" All three collected the last shellfish.
They carried their baskets up to dry sand. "Next time, I'll tell you at the start." Raju set a basket beside the younger children.
